alerts.title: Weight Gain on DTG
alerts.message: Guidelines suggest monitoring for weight gain on DTG. Patient has gained 9 kg in the past year, with a current BMI of 33. However, guidelines also note that the association between DTG and weight gain may not be causal. Non-drug causes, such as hypothyroidism, should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Monitor weight and adjust treatment as needed
